item.title: The Rookie - Czech Mate - Review: Back and Better than Ever (and yes, Chenford is back!)
item.description: Season premieres have a tough job: re-establish momentum, remind viewers why they care, and set the tone for what’s ahead. “Czech Mate” does all three, and then some. It’s one of the strongest episodes The Rookie has delivered in a long time, largely because it feels focused, connected, and confident. item.title: Scott Speedman Enters the Florida Underworld in ABC’s RJ Decker - Watch the Trailer Here
item.description: ABC is heading to South Florida this March with RJ Decker, a one-hour drama led by Scott Speedman and inspired by Double Whammy by Carl Hiaasen. The series follows Decker, a former newspaper photographer whose life unraveled after a scandal and a prison stint. Now out and looking for redemption, he reinvents himself as a private investigator navigating the vibrant, chaotic, and frequently dangerous corners of South Florida.
